title: Leeman's middle name, Spencer
summary: Hinton asks about names; Leeman reveals his unused middle name Spencer, after a grandfather.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: Now I'd like to get this -- you say your name is Cliff Leeman, and most families that I know of, especially black families, of which I am from -- we had more than one -- two names. My name is Milton John Hinton, my grandmother's name was Heddy Liddy Carter Robinson, and I noticed that you only -- and most musicians I have talked to had more than one or two names. Now there is no middle name for you?
Oh, yes; I have a middle name -- Spencer.
Oh yeah? Well, you didn't give it to me. That's the reason I ask.
Well, I never liked it so I never used it. I was named for Clifford Spencer -- was after my grandfather.
Well, for the record now, we know that you did have a middle name.
